title: Uchwyt do łóżka, bedside table, szafka nocna
author: Szronie
description:
Holder for phone in bed, bedside table

Phone holder, bedside shelf mounted to the side of the bed

Divided into two parts. The parts should be glued with ordinary glue to ensure they fit well on the given bed. Two brackets can be used for a more stable hold

You need to glue these two parts. Very easy

meta.profile_notes: print without supports. nothing special. Normal setting

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
